title: On-Call SEV-1 Incident Shift Handover & Acknowledgement Gate
required_invariants: Outgoing and incoming on-call engineers must be distinct non-empty IDs; invalid inputs raise ValueError.
Handover cannot complete if any open SEV-1 incident lacks an explicit incoming acknowledgement.
Incoming engineer must have completed current on-call readiness certification.
When all SEV-1 incidents are acknowledged and incoming engineer is certified, handover status is complete.
